description: This file contains shell functions for managing firmware upgrades and boot partition selection on a device running OpenWrt firmware, specifically tailored for Linksys hardware. It includes functions to determine the current target firmware, perform upgrade procedures, and copy configuration backups.

methods.name: linksys_get_target_firmware
methods.description: Determines the current target firmware partition by reading environment variables or system files, and toggles boot partition accordingly.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_linksys
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade process by selecting the appropriate partition and executing nand upgrade commands based on a magic number.

methods.name: platform_copy_config_linksys
methods.description: Copies the backup configuration file to the temporary system directory.
